Игра сочетает реальные демографические д: The game combines real demographic data with a deterministic random generator. Decisions change probabilities, but do not eliminate randomness completely.
Страна выбирается по доле рождений среди: The country is selected by birth share among 193 countries. Family and wealth fall out regardless of the name.
Ежемесячный риск берётся из таблиц ООН д: Monthly risk is taken from UN tables for country, gender and age. In subsequent years, the decision is little to change this underlying risk through direct action.
Без обращения риск смертности у героя с: Without reversal, the mortality risk for a hero with a severe condition starts at ×2.5. Each full year without assistance increases the multiplier by 0.5, up to a maximum of ×5.5.
Восстановление и медицинская помощь могу: Recovery and medical care can return the condition to supported treatment.
Тревога появляется после накопленного ст: Anxiety appears after accumulated stress and poor support. Loss, overload, loneliness and repeated difficult events increase accumulated stress.
Помощь близких, обращение за профессиона: Help from loved ones, seeking professional support and reducing workload can speed up recovery.
Учёба, общение и практика ежемесячно раз: Study, communication and practice develop skills monthly according to the chosen plan. Difficult decisions provide traits with specific bonuses to admission, work, and future chances.
План изменяет жизнь, но не гарантирует у: A plan changes lives, but does not guarantee the success of an action.
Редкие встречи и воспоминания имеют шанс: Rare encounters and memories have a chance of about 0.15% per eligible month. Most common events are selected based on age, schedule, environment, and recent history.
Повторные события блокируются на несколь: Repeated events are blocked for several months so that life does not turn into an endless repetition.
